news.title: Tales Take a Dark Turn in Midnight’s Talebound
news.summary: Step into Midnight’s Talebound, a PvE action RPG game mode where macabre stories come to life. Venture solo or with friends through eerie tales filled with enemies, bosses, puzzles, treasure, relics, and cosmetic rewards as you confront the terrors waiting beyond Quillgrave.

news.title: World of Warcraft at BlizzCon 2026: Discover What’s Next
news.summary: BlizzCon 2026 has begun! We’ll be updating right here throughout the weekend with the latest, announcements, reveals and updates from the convention.

news.title: Carve a New Path with World of Warcraft: Forever
news.summary: Keep up on everything announced for World of Warcraft: Forever during BlizzCon, including a first look at the next chapter for Azeroth and the adventures waiting on the horizon.

news.title: Pre-Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades
news.summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

news.title: September is a Great Month to Celebrate Friendship at the Trading Post
news.summary: September brings a friendship-themed Trading Post lineup with the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and special Outlet vendors offering discounted and returning items.

forever.launchLine: World of Warcraft: Forever launches on November 4, 2026.
forever.betaLine: Forever Beta begins on September 17, 2026, and is available through October 21, 2026.
forever.namesLine: Early Name Reservation will be available starting October 27 through November 3.
forever.collectionLine: Warcraft Forever Collection will be available through January 11, 2027.
forever.heroLine: World of Warcraft: Forever is coming November 4!
